description:
Epoch Community Web opens into a community with its own channels (Discord-like),
  with Network Feed discovery and linked repository projects as secondary planes.

elements.name: Contributor opens a community and sees community-owned channels first

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
the Community Web shows a community with channels
the active channel does not require a repository

elements.name: Contributor opens Network Feed for cross-community discovery

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I open the Network Feed
the Community Web shows the Network Feed with activity tabs

elements.name: Maintainer switches communities and gets a new channel list

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I switch to the Agent Guild community
I open the agent-runs channel
the Community Web shows the Agent Guild channels

elements.name: Maintainer promotes a community idea into an intent

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I open the ideas channel in the active community
I select the "Dashboard widget should group revenue by region" community message
I mark the selected message as an intent candidate
the live API records a change proposal for the selected conversation

elements.name: Maintainer requests an agent from a selected conversation

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I open the ideas channel in the active community
I select the "Dashboard widget should group revenue by region" community message
I request an agent from the selected message
the selected message shows that human review remains required

elements.name: Maintainer recovers a signed action from snapshot mode

steps.name: Community Web is running from an honest snapshot
the snapshot banner explains how to reconnect for signed work
I open the ideas channel in the active community
I select the "Dashboard widget should group revenue by region" community message
I mark the selected message as an intent candidate
the selected message explains how to reconnect and retry Mark intent

elements.name: Contributor adds a unified signed comment to the current channel

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I open the ideas channel in the active community
I add a community reply "Keyboard navigation works in the preview."
the reply appears in the message feed with signed comment metadata

elements.name: Contributor reaches a channel conversation on a narrow screen

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I use Community Web at a narrow mobile width
the active conversation remains reachable without an oversized navigation rail
I can browse each navigation group without horizontal page overflow
conversation reactions meet the Community touch-target floor
Community state remains readable and announced
the current channel context remains labeled

elements.name: Contributor keeps community content in reach at 200 percent zoom

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I zoom Community Web to 200 percent in a short viewport
the zoomed navigation remains bounded above community content
the zoomed document has no horizontal page overflow

elements.name: Moderator reports a selected conversation for legal hold

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I open the ideas channel in the active community
I select the "Dashboard widget should group revenue by region" community message
I report the selected message
the selected message shows legal-hold evidence status

elements.name: Contributor searches community receipts by harness and intent

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I search community receipts for "goose"
the receipt search reports at least one match
a visible agent receipt includes harness "goose"

elements.name: Maintainer sees promote receipt after recording an intent

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
I open the ideas channel in the active community
I select the "Dashboard widget should group revenue by region" community message
I mark the selected message as an intent candidate
the Community Web shows a signed promote receipt for the new proposal

elements.name: Contributor sees state-driven identity honesty on a live API session

steps.name: the Community Web live API has repository activity
I open the Community Web channel experience
the identity chip uses auth state "api-session"
the identity chip explains that AT OAuth is not linked

name: Community Web community-first experience
